newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia aims to boost domestic coffee consumption.
newsitem.headline: Colombia aims to boost domestic coffee consumption.

text.p: BOGOTA, May 2 Reuter - Colombia will launch a plan to boost the domestic consumption of coffee in mid-May, coffee sources said.

Alberto Jaramillo, executive director of the Departmental Coffee Growers' Committee in central Caldas province, told the respected El Espectador newspaper that the project would be headed by the powerful National Coffee Growers' Federation.
Colombians currently drink an average 2.6 pounds (1.2 kg) of coffee a year, 110 times less than the average Scandinavian, Jaramillo said.

Colombia, the world's second largest coffee producer after Brazil, currently consumes just eight percent of its annual coffee crop, the remainder is exported. Jaramillo said the long-term aim of the federation's promotion campaign was to more than double domestic consumption.
